original: <6.1.46> ata evāsyāpi paryanuyogasyānavakāśaḥ | yadi dravyasya pratigrahe prācīnabhojanadvārā pratigrahopakārakatvam iṣyate tadā janmata ārabhya bhojanaṃ vinā śarīrāvasthiter abhāvān nārjanaṃ saṃbhavatīti sarva eva dhanopayaḥ pitṛdravyavināśena syāt | ato "anupaghnan pitṛdravyam" iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na syād iti | yato viśeṣanānarthakyād eva bhakṣaṇādyupabhogopayuktadhanopaghātād anyasyaivopaghātādirūpasya vacanārthatvāt |
analyzed: atas eva asya api paryanuyogasya anavakāśaḥ yadi dravyasya pratigrahe prācīnabhojana dvārā pratigraha upakāraka tvam iṣyate tadā janmataḥ ārabhya bhojanam vinā śarīra avasthiteḥ abhāvāt na arjanam saṃbhavati iti sarvaḥ eva dhana upayaḥ pitṛ dravya vināśena syāt atas anupaghnan pitṛ dravyam iti viśeṣaṇam na syāt iti yatas viśeṣana ānarthakyāt eva bhakṣaṇa ādi upabhoga upayukta dhana upaghātāt anyasya eva upaghāta ādi rūpasya vacana artha tvāt

original: <6.1.47> kiṃ ca bhakṣaṇādyupabhogārthaṃ dhanopaghātasya gṛhagatenāpy avaśyakartavyatvān na dhanārjanārthatvam upaghātasya | tādarthyam eva ca prayojakam iti nātiprasaktiḥ |
analyzed: kim ca bhakṣaṇa ādi upabhoga artham dhana upaghātasya gṛha gatena api avaśya kartavya tvāt na dhana arjana artha tvam upaghātasya tādarthyam eva ca prayojakam iti na ati prasaktiḥ

original: <6.1.48> ata evoktaṃ viśvarūpeṇa [1]— pitṛdravyaṃ datvā yadi nopārjitaṃ dhanaṃ tadā tasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ vaivāhikavad evoktam | na tu bhakṣaṇādyupabhogamātreṇa tasya stanyapānāditulyatvād ity anena |

analyzed: jitendreṇa api bahu prakāram vimṛśya uktam tat asya yāvat ukta prapañcasya saṃkṣepeṇa ayam arthaḥ pratyetavyaḥ yat kiṃcid dhanam asādhāraṇa dhana upaghāta arjitam tat asādhāraṇam yat kiṃcid dhanam sādhāraṇa upārjitam tat sādhāraṇam visparṣṭa artham tu vidyā dhanam tu yat yasya ityādinā udāharaṇa prapañcena upanyastam asādhāraṇa tvāt eva avibhājyam evaṃvidham dhanam sādhāraṇam api sādhāraṇa hetu samuttham evaṃvidham eva tat api sukha avabho

original: <11.1.8> tatpiṇḍam ity atas tad ity anuṣajyate | tacchabdena bhartuḥ parāmarśād bhartuḥ kṛtsnam aṃśaṃ patnī labheta na tu svāṃśaṃ kṛtsnam ity arthaḥ | kṛtsnasvāṃśoddeśena labheteti vidhānānupapatteḥ svāmibhāvajñāpanārthatvād asya | na ca svāṃśe svāmibhāvajñāpanam arhati svāṃśajñāpanenaiva jñātatvāt |
analyzed: tat piṇḍam iti atas tat iti anuṣajyate tad śabdena bhartuḥ parāmarśāt bhartuḥ kṛtsnam aṃśam patnī labheta na tu sva aṃśam kṛtsnam iti arthaḥ kṛtsna sva aṃśa uddeśena labheta iti vidhāna anupapatteḥ svāmi bhāva jñāpana artha tvāt asya na ca sva aṃśe svāmi bhāva jñāpanam arhati sva aṃśa jñāpanena eva jñāta tvāt

original: <11.1.9> na ca grahaṇavidhānārthaṃ tad iti vācyam | svadhanagrahaṇasya rāgād eva prāptatvāt |
analyzed: na ca grahaṇa vidhāna artham tat iti vācyam sva dhana grahaṇasya rāgāt eva prāpta tvāt

original: <11.1.10> na ca niyamārthaṃ vacanam iti vācyam | adṛṣṭārthatvāpatteḥ | niyame ca niyojyādikalpanam api syāt |
analyzed: na ca niyama artham vacanam iti vācyam adṛṣṭa artha tva āpatteḥ niyame ca niyojya ādi kalpanam api syāt

original: <11.1.11> yac coktam — na hy anandhādiḥ putro 'ṃśaṃ kṛtsnaṃ labhetety ukte pitryaṃ kṛtsnam aṃśam iti kiṃ tarhi kṛtsnaṃ svāṃśam iti | tathātrāpi kṛtsnaṃ svāṃśāpekṣam iti |
analyzed: yat ca uktam na hi an andha ādiḥ putraḥ oṃśam kṛtsnam labheta iti ukte pitryam kṛtsnam aṃśam iti kim tarhi kṛtsnam sva aṃśam iti tathā atra api kṛtsnam sva aṃśa apekṣam iti

original: tan na | anandhādiḥ putro 'ṃśaṃ kṛtsnaṃ labheteti vacanābhāvād dṛṣṭāntānupapatteḥ | bhavatu vā | tathāpi pūrvoktahetunā svāṃśaṃ labheteti vidhyanupapatteḥ pitrāṃśāpekṣam eva varṇanaṃ yuktam | <11.1.12> ata eva sarvatrānyadhana evānyasaṃbandhajñāpanaṃ munayaḥ kurvanti | yathā pitṛdhane putrāṇām aputradhane patnyādīnām ityādi | na punaḥ svāṃśagrahaṇe prerayanti |
analyzed: tat na an andha ādiḥ putraḥ oṃśam kṛtsnam labheta iti vacana abhāvāt dṛṣṭānta anupapatteḥ bhavatu vā tathā api pūrva ukta hetunā sva aṃśam labheta iti vidhi anupapatteḥ pitra aṃśa apekṣam eva varṇanam yuktam atas eva sarvatra anya dhane eva anya saṃbandha jñāpanam munayaḥ kurvanti yathā pitṛ dhane putrāṇām aputra dhane patnī ādīnām ityādi na punar sva aṃśa grahaṇe prerayanti

original: <11.1.13> yac ca saṃbandhiśabdhatvena svasaṃbandhyupasthāpakatvam | yathā māteti na paramātāvagamyata ity uktam |
analyzed: yat ca saṃbandhi śabdha tvena sva saṃbandhi upasthāpaka tvam yathā mātā iti na para mātā avagamyate iti uktam

original: tad apy ayuktam | anupāttasaṃbandhiviṣayatvāt tasya | na hi ḍitthasya mātaram ānayety ukte prayojyasya mātāvagamyate prayojakasya vā | tadvad atrāpi tatpiṇḍam iti tatpadopāttatvāt saṃbandhinaḥ kathaṃ patnyapkṣitā | vidhānānupapattiś ca pūrvam uktaiva |
analyzed: tat api ayuktam anupātta saṃbandhi viṣaya tvāt tasya na hi ḍitthasya mātaram ānaya iti ukte prayojyasya mātā avagamyate prayojakasya vā tadvat atra api tat piṇḍam iti tad pada upātta tvāt saṃbandhinaḥ katham vidhāna anupapattiḥ ca pūrvam uktā eva

original: <11.1.14> tasmāt kṛtsnaṃ tadaṃśagrahaṇam eva patnyā vṛddhamanur bodhayati |
analyzed: tasmāt kṛtsnam tad aṃśa grahaṇam eva patnyāḥ vṛddha manuḥ bodhayati

original: iti putraduhitṛpatnīpitṝṇām abhāve saṃsṛṣṭasya sodarabhrātur adhikāraṃ bodhayatīti kathaṃ tasya patnībādhakatvam |

original: <11.1.22> kiṃ ca na lupyata iti | avibhaktatve saṃsṛṣṭatve ca bhrātrantarīyadravyamiśrībhūtasya pṛthag apratītau lopāśaṅkāyāṃ na lupyata iti vacanam upapadyate | vibhaktasyāsaṃsṛṣṭasya tu dhane vibhaktatvaprītau kā lopāśaṅkā |
analyzed: kim ca na lupyate iti avibhakta tve saṃsṛṣṭa tve ca bhrātṛ antarīya dravya miśrībhūtasya pṛthak apratītau lopa āśaṅkāyām na lupyate iti vacanam upapadyate vibhaktasya asaṃsṛṣṭasya tu dhane vibhakta tva prītau kā lopa āśaṅkā

original: tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayatvam evāmīṣāṃ vacanānām |
analyzed: tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭa viṣaya tvam eva amīṣām vacanānām

original: <11.1.23> kiṃ c patnyādeḥ pūrvaṃ bhrātradhikārajñāpakaśaṅkhādivacanānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭabhrātṛviṣayatvaṃ vacanād vā nyāyād vā | tatra na tāvad vacanād viśeṣavacanābhāvāt | saṃsṛṣṭinas tu saṃsṛṣṭītyādivacanānāṃ tu bhrātradhikārāvasare viśeṣajñāpanaparatvena bhrātradhikāramātraparatvānupapatteḥ | <11.1.24> anantaropanyastabṛhaspativacanānāṃ ca saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayatve putraduhitṛpatnīpitṛparyantābhāve (-paryantarābhāve ?) sodarabhrātradhikārajñāpakatvāt tadviruddhatvād asaṃsṛṣṭaviṣayatvam eva tāvad yuktaṃ na tu saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayatvam |
analyzed: patnī ādeḥ pūrvam bhrātṛ adhikāra jñāpaka śaṅkha ādi vacanānām saṃsṛṣṭa bhrātṛ viṣaya tvam vacanāt vā nyāyāt vā tatra na tāvat vacanāt viśeṣa vacana abhāvāt saṃsṛṣṭinaḥ tu saṃsṛṣṭi ityādi vacanānām tu bhrātṛ adhikāra avasare viśeṣa jñāpana paratvena bhrātṛ adhikāra mātra paratva anupapatteḥ anantara upanyasta bṛhaspati vacanānām ca saṃsṛṣṭa viṣaya tve putra duhitṛ patnī pitṛ paryanta abhāve paryantara abhāve

original: <11.1.25> atha nyāyād idam abhidhīyate | tathā hi saṃsṛṣṭatve yad ekasya bhrātur dhanaṃ tad aparasyāpi | tatraikasya maraṇena svatvanāśe 'pi jīvatas tatra svāmitvānapāyāt tasyaiva tad bhavati na tu patnyā bhartṛmaraṇena patnīsvatvasyāpi nāśāt | yathā satsu putrādiṣu na taddhanaṃ patnyā iti |
analyzed: atha nyāyāt idam abhidhīyate tathā hi saṃsṛṣṭa tve yat ekasya bhrātuḥ dhanam tat aparasya api tatra ekasya maraṇena svatva nāśe jīvataḥ tatra svāmi tva anapāyāt tasya eva tat bhavati na tu patnyāḥ bhartṛ maraṇena patnī svatvasya api nāśāt yathā satsu putra ādiṣu na tat dhanam patnyāḥ iti

original: <11.1.26> tan mandam | na hi saṃsṛṣṭatve 'pi yad evaikasya tad aparasyāpi | kiṃ tv avijñātaikadeśaviṣayam | tad dvayor na tu samagram eva | samagrasvatvakalpanāpramāṇābhāvād ity uktam ādāv eva | pariṇayanotpannaṃ bhartṛdhane patnyāḥ svāmitvam | bhartṛmanarān naśyatīty atra ca pramāṇābhāvāt | sati tu putre tadadhikāraśāstrād eva patnīsvatvanāśo 'vagamyate |
analyzed: tat mandam na hi saṃsṛṣṭa tve yat eva ekasya tat aparasya api kim tu avijñāta eka deśa viṣayam tat dvayoḥ na tu samagram eva samagra svatva kalpanā pramāṇa abhāvāt iti uktam ādau eva pariṇayana utpannam bhartṛ dhane patnyāḥ svāmi tvam naśyati iti atra ca pramāṇa abhāvāt sati tu putre tad adhikāra śāstrāt eva patnī svatva nāśaḥ vagamyate

original: <11.1.27> atrāpi saṃsṛṣṭabhrātradhikāraśāstrāt tadvināśo 'vagamyata iti cen na saṃsṛṣṭabhrātṛgocaratvasyādyāpy asiddheḥ | siddhe hi bhrātṛsaṃsṛṣṭabhartṛmaraṇena patnīsvāmitvanāśe bhrātradhikāraśāstrasya saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayatvam | sati ca tadviṣayatve śāstrasya patnīsvāmitvanāśa itītaretarāśrayatvam |
analyzed: atra api saṃsṛṣṭa bhrātṛ adhikāra śāstrāt tad vināśaḥ vagamyate iti ced na saṃsṛṣṭa bhrātṛ gocaratvasya adya api asiddheḥ siddhe hi bhrātṛ saṃsṛṣṭa bhartṛ maraṇena patnī svāmi tva nāśe bhrātṛ adhikāra śāstrasya saṃsṛṣṭa viṣaya tvam sati ca tad viṣaya tve śāstrasya patnī svāmi tva nāśe iti itaretarāśraya tvam

original: <11.1.28> kiṃ ca śaṅkhalikhitādivacanānām avibhaktasaṃsṛṣṭagocaratve 'vibhaktasya saṃsṛṣṭasya ca dhanaṃ tadvidhabhrātṛgāmi | tasya tu tathāvidhasyābhāve pitarau haretām ity anvayo vācyaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca śaṅkha likhita ādi vacanānām avibhakta saṃsṛṣṭa gocara tve vibhaktasya saṃsṛṣṭasya ca dhanam tadvidha bhrātṛ gāmi tasya tu tathāvidhasya abhāve pitarau haretām iti anvayaḥ vācyaḥ

original: tathā ca vikalpanīyam | kiṃ vibhaktāsaṃsṛṣṭau pitarau gṛhṇīyātām | utāvibhaktasaṃsṛṣṭau |
analyzed: tathā ca vikalpanīyam kim vibhakta asaṃsṛṣṭau pitarau gṛhṇīyātām uta avibhakta saṃsṛṣṭau

original: na tatra prathamaḥ kalpaḥ | patnī duhitaraś cetyādinā vibhaktāsaṃsṛṣṭayoḥ pitroḥ patnībādhyatvā kathaṃ patnītaḥ pūrvaṃ tayor adhikāraḥ |
analyzed: na tatra prathamaḥ kalpaḥ patnī duhitaraḥ ca ityādinā vibhakta asaṃsṛṣṭayoḥ pitroḥ katham patnī itas pūrvam tayoḥ adhikāraḥ

original: nāpi dvitīyaḥ | avibhaktasaṃsṛṣṭabhrātṛsadbhāve 'py avibhaktasaṃsṛṣṭapitṛgrāhyatvasya sarveṣām avivādāt |
analyzed: nā api dvitīyaḥ avibhakta saṃsṛṣṭa bhrātṛ sadbhāve pi avibhakta saṃsṛṣṭa pitṛ grāhya tvasya sarveṣām avivādāt

original: <11.1.29> kiṃ ca yathā pitrā bhrātrā ca vibhaktāsaṃsṛṣṭadhane śarīradātṛtayā ātmā vai jāyate putra ity ekatvaśruter dhanaśarīrayoś ca prabhutvāt tatpitṛdeyapitāmahaprapitāmahapiṇḍadvaye ca sapiṇḍanena mṛtasya bhoktṛtvāj jīvati ca pitari putrāṇāṃ pārvaṇapiṇḍadānābhāvāt bhrātṛbhyaḥ pūrvaṃ pitur adhikāraḥ tathetaratrāpi yuktaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca yathā pitrā bhrātrā ca vibhakta asaṃsṛṣṭa dhane śarīra dātṛtayā ātmā vai jāyate putraḥ iti ekatva śruteḥ dhana śarīrayoḥ ca prabhu tvāt tad pitṛ deya pitāmaha prapitāmaha piṇḍa dvaye ca sapiṇḍanena mṛtasya bhoktṛtvāt jīvati ca pitari putrāṇām pārvaṇa piṇḍa dāna abhāvāt bhrātṛbhyaḥ pūrvam pituḥ adhikāraḥ tathā itaratra api yuktaḥ

original: avibhāgasaṃsargayor vāviśeṣāt pitṛbhrārtos tulayavad adhikāro yuktaḥ | na tu bhrātur abhāve pitur iti yuktam |
analyzed: avibhāga saṃsargayoḥ vā aviśeṣāt pitṛ bhrārtoḥ tulaya vat adhikāraḥ yuktaḥ na tu bhrātuḥ abhāve pituḥ iti yuktam

original: <11.1.30> kiṃ cāvibhaktasaṃsṛṣṭau pitarau gṛhṇīyātām iti dvivacanam anupapannam | mātrā saha vibhāgāvibhāgayor abhāvāt | ata eva saṃsargābhāvo 'pi | yad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
analyzed: kim ca avibhakta saṃsṛṣṭau pitarau gṛhṇīyātām iti dvivacanam anupapannam mātrā saha vibhāga avibhāgayoḥ abhāvāt atas eva saṃsarga abhāvaḥ yat āha bṛhaspatiḥ

original: vibhakto yaḥ punaḥ pitrā bhrātrā vaikatra saṃsthitaḥ |
analyzed: vibhaktaḥ yaḥ punar pitrā bhrātrā vā ekatra saṃsthitaḥ

original: pitṛveṇātha vā prītyā sa tu saṃsṛṣṭa ucyate || [B 26.113]
analyzed: pitṛ veṇā atha vā prītyā sa tu saṃsṛṣṭaḥ ucyate

original: anenaitad darśayati — yeṣām eva hi pitṛbhrātṛpitṛvyādīnāṃ pitṛpitāmahārjitadravyeṇāvibhaktatvam utpattitaḥ saṃbhavati ta eva vibhaktāḥ santaḥ parasparaprītyā yadi pūrvakṛtavibhāgadhvaṃsena yat tava dhanaṃ tan mama yan mama dhanaṃ tat taveti ekagṛha ekagṛhirūpatayā saṃsthitāḥ sasṛjyante |
analyzed: anena etat darśayati yeṣām eva hi pitṛ bhrātṛ pitṛvya ādīnām pitṛ pitāmaha arjita dravyeṇa avibhakta tvam utpattitaḥ saṃbhavati te eva vibhaktāḥ santaḥ paraspara prītyā yadi pūrva kṛta vibhāga dhvaṃsena yat tava dhanam tat mama yat mama dhanam tat tava iti eka gṛhe eka gṛhi rūpa tayā saṃsthitāḥ sasṛjyante

original: na punar anevaṃrūpāṇāṃ dravyasaṃsargamātreṇa saṃbhūya vaṇijām api saṃsargatvam | nāpi vibhaktānāṃ dravyasaṃsargamātreṇa pūrvoktaprītipūrvakābhisaṃdhānaṃ vinā | ataḥ saṃsargitvāvibhaktatvayor mātrā sahāsaṃbhavāt kathaṃ mātṛgato bhrātṛsadbhāvādhikāravirodhaḥ samādheyaḥ |

original: "tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭinas tu saṃsṛṣṭīti saṃsṛṣṭadhane sāmānyataḥ saṃsṛṣṭino bhāgaprāptau tadapavādārthaṃ sodarasya tu sodara iti vacanam | evaṃ ca saṃsṛṣṭino 'py asodarasya sodare sati na prāptiḥ | kiṃ tarhi vibhāgasaṃsṛṣṭasyāsaṃsṛṣṭasya vā sodarasyaiva vibhāga ity antam" |

original: tathā hi upātra vapantīti vedividhisāpekṣo niṣedhas tadbādhaṃ vinā vidhir eva na syād iti vedividhibādhasāpekṣaṃ vidhānam | na ca nityavad eva tasya bādhaḥ | tathā ca sati niṣedho viphalaḥ | niṣedhaṃ vināpi vedyakaraṇasya prāpteḥ | tataś ca vedividhir api niṣedhavidhibādhasāpekṣavidhibhāvaḥ | parvadvaye tu nirapekṣa iti bhavati | vidhivairūpyaṃ vikalpaś ca syāt | rāgaprāpte tu nityavad bādhaḥ kādācitkasyākaraṇasya niṣedham antareṇa prāpteḥ |

original: <11.5.24> ye tu bruvate — yādṛcchikagrahaṇaprāptiniṣedho 'yaṃ na tu vidhitaḥ prāptasyeti | tad atīvājñavacanam | vaidhagrahaṇasyāvaidhagrahaṇaniṣedhasya ca yugapadupasaṃhārāsaṃbhavād dvikalpābhāvaprasakteḥ | kratvarthatayā ca yādṛcchikagrahaṇaprasaktyabhāvān niṣedho na kratvarthaḥ syāt |
analyzed: ye tu bruvate yādṛcchika grahaṇa prāpti niṣedhaḥ yam na tu vidhitaḥ prāptasya iti tat atīva ajña vacanam vaidha grahaṇasya avaidha grahaṇa niṣedhasya ca yugapad upasaṃhāra asaṃbhavāt dvi kalpa abhāva prasakteḥ kratu artha tayā ca yādṛcchika grahaṇa prasakti abhāvāt niṣedhaḥ na kratu arthaḥ syāt

original: <11.5.26> yac ca svayam eva varṇitam — asodare saṃsṛṣṭini sodare cāsaṃsṛṣṭini saṃsṛṣṭinas tu saṃsṛṣṭīty anenāsodarasya dhanasaṃbandhaprāptau tadapavādārthaṃ sodarasya tu sodara iti vacanaṃ tad apy ayuktam | asminn eva viṣaye sodarasya tu sodara iti sodarasya dhanasaṃbandhaprasaktau tadapavādarthaṃ saṃsṛṣṭivacanasyāpi saṃbhavād vinigamanākāraṇābhāvāt |
analyzed: yat ca svayam eva varṇitam asodare saṃsṛṣṭini sodare ca asaṃsṛṣṭini saṃsṛṣṭinaḥ tu saṃsṛṣṭī iti anena asodarasya dhana saṃbandha prāptau tad apavāda artham sodarasya tu sodaraḥ iti vacanam tat api ayuktam asmin eva viṣaye sodarasya tu sodaraḥ iti sodarasya dhana saṃbandha prasaktau tad apavāda artham saṃsṛṣṭi vacanasya api saṃbhavāt vinigamana akāraṇa abhāvāt

original: <11.5.27> yac ca saṃsṛṣṭinas tu saṃsṛṣṭīty etadvivaraṇārthatvenānyodarya iti vacanaṃ vyākhyātam | tad apy atīvāyuktam | anyodaryavacanād eva vivakṣitārthalābhāt saṃsṛṣṭina ity asyānarthakyāpatteḥ |
analyzed: yat ca saṃsṛṣṭinaḥ tu saṃsṛṣṭī iti etad vivaraṇa arthatvena anya udaryaḥ iti vacanam vyākhyātam tat api atīva ayuktam anya udarya vacanāt eva vivakṣita artha lābhāt saṃsṛṣṭinaḥ iti asya ānarthakya āpatteḥ

original: <11.5.28> kiṃ cānyodaryas tu saṃsṛṣṭīty asyāyam arthaḥ — anyodaryas tu saṃsṛṣṭī yaḥ sa nānyodaryadhanaṃ haret | kiṃ tv asaṃsṛṣṭy api sodarapadānuṣaṅgāt sodara eva gṛhṇīyāt | saṃsṛṣṭo 'pi nānyamātṛjo gṛhṇīyād iti vyākhyātam | tad api na | pūrvārdha ekasyānyodaryapadasya punaruktatvāt | tathottarārdhe 'pi nānyamatṛja ity asyānarthakyāpatteḥ | apiśabdasya caivakārārthe 'varṇāt |
analyzed: kim ca anya udaryaḥ tu saṃsṛṣṭī iti asya ayam arthaḥ anya udaryaḥ tu saṃsṛṣṭī yaḥ sa na anya udarya dhanam haret kim tu asaṃsṛṣṭī api sodara pada anuṣaṅgāt sodaraḥ eva gṛhṇīyāt saṃsṛṣṭaḥ pi na anya mātṛ jaḥ gṛhṇīyāt iti vyākhyātam tat api na pūrva ardhe ekasya anya udarya padasya punarukta tvāt tathā uttara ardhe pi na anya mātṛ jaḥ iti asya ānarthakya āpatteḥ apiśabdasya ca eva kāra arthe varṇāt

original: <11.5.29> kiṃ ca sodare cāsaṃsṛṣṭini asodarasya saṃsṛṣṭino 'pavādārthaṃ sodaravacanasya varṇitatvāt | sodarāsodarayor asaṃsṛṣṭinor apravṛttatvāt tulyavad evādhikāraḥ syān na vā kasyacid api syāt | <11.5.30> athātrāpi sodaravacanam eva pravartate tadaikatra saṃsṛṣṭivacanabādhasāpekṣam anyatra tu bādhānapekṣam iti bhavatām eva vidhivairūpyam | yathā some vidhīyamānā vedir dīkṣaṇīyādiṣv atideśaprāptavedibādhenānyatra bādhaṃ vinaiveti vairūpyād avedimatāṃ tad draṣṭavyam ity uktam |
analyzed: kim ca sodare ca asaṃsṛṣṭini asodarasya upavāda artham sodara vacanasya varṇita tvāt sodara asodarayoḥ asaṃsṛṣṭinoḥ apravṛtta tvāt tulya vat eva adhikāraḥ syāt na vā kasyacid api syāt atha atra api sodara vacanam eva pravartate tadā ekatra saṃsṛṣṭi vacana bādha sāpekṣam anyatra tu bādha anapekṣam iti bhavatām eva vidhi vairūpyam yathā some vidhīyamānā vediḥ dīkṣaṇīya ādiṣu atideśa prāpta vedi bādhena anyatra bādham vinā eva iti vairūpya

original: <11.5.31> asmin mate tu śrīkarasaṃmatam api vidhivairūpyaṃ nāsti | saṃsṛṣṭisodaravacanayor ekaikaviṣayatvād anyodaryavacanasya ca sodarasyāsaṃsṛṣṭinaḥ saṃsṛṣṭinaś cāsodarasya tulyavad adhikārajñāpanārthatvāt | tathā hi anyodaryas tu saṃsṛṣṭī san saty api sodare 'saṃsṛṣṭini dhanaṃ haret | nānyodaryo 'saṃsṛṣṭy api gṛhṇīyād iti pūrvārdhasyārthaḥ | tatra kiṃ sodaras tadānīṃ na gṛhṇīyād evety apekṣāyām uttarārdhenottaram | asaṃsṛṣṭy api cādadyāt | sodara ity anuṣajyate | saṃsṛṣṭo 'nyamātṛja eva na kevalaḥ kiṃ tūbhābhyāṃ vibhajya grahītavyam ity arthaḥ|
analyzed: asmin mate tu śrī kara saṃmatam api vidhi vairūpyam na asti saṃsṛṣṭi sodara vacanayoḥ ekaika viṣaya tvāt anyodarya vacanasya ca sodarasya asaṃsṛṣṭinaḥ saṃsṛṣṭinaḥ ca asodarasya tulya vat adhikāra jñāpana artha tvāt tathā hi anyodaryaḥ tu saṃsṛṣṭī san sati api sodare saṃsṛṣṭini dhanam haret na anyodaryaḥ saṃsṛṣṭī api gṛhṇīyāt iti pūrva ardhasya arthaḥ tatra kim sodaraḥ tadānīm na gṛhṇīyāt eva iti apekṣāyām uttara
